crossRefs.note: You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.
For who in the skies can be compared to Yahweh? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like Yahweh,
You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.
The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.
and said, ‘You may come here, but no further. Your proud waves shall be stopped here?’
Don’t you fear me?’ says Yahweh ‘Won’t you tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea…
A big wind storm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so much that the boat was already filled.

translations.web: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, Yahweh on high is mighty.
translations.bsb: Above the roar of many waters— the mighty breakers of the sea— the LORD on high is majestic.
translations.kjv: The LORD on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.
translations.asv: Above the voices of many waters, The mighty breakers of the sea, Jehovah on high is mighty.
